posts.cooked: Fighting the Ennead right now, and a hypothetical occurred to me while I was resolving Elemental Storm (which might apply to other Ennead cards or even to cards in some other decks, not sure).  Elemental Storm reads "The villain target with the lowest HP deals each hero target 1 lightning, 1 fire, and 1 cold".  Say the lowest-HP Ennead member is Atum, and he's got 2 HP left (or 1 HP and Nuit is in play).  Absolute Zero has his Isothermic Transducer and Focused Apertures in play, so when Atum hits him for 1 Fire damage, he retaliates with 2 cold damage, killing Atum.  Does this abort the resolution of Elemental Storm, since the Ennie who was unleashing the Storm went down?  Or does the Storm continue resolving with the next lowest-HP Ennie now being the source of the damage?

I can think of more clear wordings for this card for either of the intended effects.

Version A - Killing the Ennie stops the Storm.

Elemental Storm

Choose the villain target with the lowest HP.  That target deals each hero target 1 lightning damage, 1 fire damage, and 1 cold damage.

Version B - The Storm cannot be stopped!

Elemental Storm

The villain target with the lowest HP deals each hero target 1 lightning damage.  The villain target with the lowest HP deals each hero target 1 fire damage.  The villain target with the lowest HP deals each hero target 1 cold damage.

I can't think of a way to make Version B hit the other heroes with Fire even if AZ kills the Fire-caster after being hit.  But at least with this version, the Cold happens after the Fire-caster is killed.  Version A is the way I assume it actually works, but I could see the argument for otherwise.

Here are the possible senarios, some which we have not entertained, but I thought it worth bringing them up in one place.

Atum is the lowest HP villain with 1 HP. He starts to deal the 3 instances of damage to all heros after playing Elemental Storm. First he hits Ra with Flame Barrier with the first instance, which reacts and kills Atum. Set has 2 HP and is now the lowest. What happens next?

A) Atum was the damage source and is destroyed, so the entire damage sequence is interupted totally

B) Set is the next lowest HP villain and will continue to damage Ra with the 2nd and 3rd instance of damage before moving on to the other heros

C) Set is the next lowest HP villain. Ra is spared the 2nd and 3rd instance of damage from destroying Atum (since destroying the source should interupt damage sequences), but Set will continue to deal damage to the other heros in Atums absence.
